_readme: Captain's Log. APPEND new entries at the END of the list (later in the file = newer on the same date). The site sorts by date, newest first. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD, required), title (required), body (required; blank line = new paragraph), tags (optional list), link (optional {label, url}). English, Rovi's voice.

entries.title: Signal detected: Quarantine Signal
entries.body: A new Blue Mold transmission is in production. Melodic metalcore, sci-fi horror, a distress beacon nobody should answer. Do not answer.

entries.title: Earth Files #006 queued: Mount Rainier, 1947
entries.body: June 1947. A private pilot reports nine bright objects skipping across the sky near Mount Rainier, Washington. The bipeds named it the start of the flying saucer era. I named it a navigation error. Not mine.

link.label: Rovi on Earth Files on YouTube

entries.title: Bridge systems online
entries.body:
Observation deck of the Blue Mold is now open to biological units with a browser. Hull at minus 142 °C. Oxygen at 20.9 %. The mold on the window frame is glowing again. I did not ask it to.

Pick a station. Shadow is watching you pick.
